Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You go still for a moment, then answer in a language you have never learned. The spirit inside you remembers it for you.

Rules

Action
Maneuver in combat, or one minute out of combat
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self; one language you hear spoken.
Duration
Until the end of the scene.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once per scene; one language at a time.
Type
Signature

A spirit that knows the language possesses you. You understand and speak that language for the scene. You do not read or write it.

Additional rulings
